findings.summary: Acoustica is a digital audio editor by Acon Digital available in Standard and Premium editions. It provides core editing features such as single-track clip editing and multitrack sessions, alongside batch processing and audio CD project support. The software includes real-time analysis tools for level metering (RMS, peak, peak hold), loudness metering (EBU R-128), spectrum analysis, and phase correlation metering. Audio recording supports resolutions up to 32-bit depth and 192 kHz sampling rate. Premium Edition adds spectral editing, multi-channel support up to 7.1.2, and a large collection of VST, VST3, Audio Units, and AAX plug-ins, including an ARA2 clip editor. Both editions share the same basic feature set.

mechanisms.title: Real-time analysis pipeline
mechanisms.explanation: The software processes audio for real-time display of level metering (RMS, peak, peak hold), loudness metering (EBU R-128), spectrum analysis, and phase correlation metering during playback or recording sessions.

mechanisms.title: Edition-specific processing architecture
mechanisms.explanation: Standard Edition provides processing tools for mastering, audio restoration, and sound design. Premium Edition extends this architecture with spectral editing, multi-channel support up to 7.1.2 channels, and a large collection of VST, VST3, Audio Units, and AAX plug-ins, including an ARA2 clip editor for host application integration.
